title: HenArt launches Levendo dog food with Enifer mycoprotein
summary: The baked, complete food for adult and senior dogs marks the first international consumer launch for Enifer’s Pekilo fermented...
ai_summary: HenArt introduces Levendo dog food featuring Enifer mycoprotein, offering a baked, complete meal for adult and senior dogs. This marks Enifer’s first international consumer launch of its Pekilo fermented product.
